readme:
# Zhihu Answer Details API Returns the full record for one Zhihu answer: the HTML body, an excerpt, timestamps, the author, the parent question and a share text. It needs one input, the numeric `answer_id` from the answer page URL. ## Use cases - Archive the full HTML body of a Zhihu answer together with its `created_time` and `updated_time`. - Link an answer back to its parent question using `question.id` and `question.title`. - Collect author names and profile tokens for answers you have already found. - Build share messages or citations from the ready-made `share_text` and `url` values. ## Request ```bash curl -X POST "https://api.sandbase.ai/v1/api/zhihu/web/answer-detail" \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBASE_API_KEY" \ -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ -d '{"answer_id": "2054145988235880002"}' ``` The result is returned in `outputs[0].data`. ## Parameters | Name | Type | Required | Description | |---|---|---|---| | `answer_id` | string | Yes | Answer ID (the numeric id in the page URL .../answer/{answer_id}) | ## Example response Real response for the request above, trimmed: lists keep their first item and long strings are cut. ```json { "allow_segment_interaction": 1, "answer_type": "normal", "author": { "avatar_url": "https://picx.zhimg.com/v2-497a418999540453d381c2a22d40759c_l.jpg?source=2c26e567", "avatar_url_template": "https://pic1.zhimg.com/v2-497a418999540453d381c2a22d40759c.jpg?source=2c26e567", "badge": [], "badge_v2": { "detail_badges": [], "icon": "", "merged_badges": [], "night_icon": "", "title": "我不癫 文集搜索：《白泽合集》 天瞳搜：《天瞳大全》" }, "gender": 0, "headline": "我不癫 文集搜索：《白泽合集》 天瞳搜：《天瞳大全》", "id": "974e867264de46d0cab4c9420eb421fc", "is_advertiser": false, "is_org": false, "is_privacy": false, "name": "白泽丧葬用品店", "type": "people" }, "biz_ext": { "share_guide": { "has_positive_bubble": false, "has_time_bubble": false, "hit_share_guide_cluster": false } }, "content": "

我哥是万年老二，再一次输给傅寒澈，他说他得了绝症。

「妹！哥没…", "content_need_truncated": false, "created_time": 1782526567, "excerpt": "我哥是万年老二，再一次输给傅寒澈，他说他得了绝症。 「妹！哥没多少日子了，哥这辈子就想赢傅寒澈一次，就一次！」 看着我哥省吃俭用刚给我买的限量款包包，我咽了咽口…", "extras": "", "force_login_when_click_read_more": false, "id": "2054145988235880002", "is_collapsed": false } ``` ## Response fields | Field | Meaning | |---|---| | `content` | Full answer body as HTML. Paragraphs are `

` tags with a `data-pid` attribute. | | `excerpt` | Plain-text preview of the start of the answer. | | `created_time / updated_time` | Unix timestamps for when the answer was created and last updated. The values look like seconds. | | `id / type / answer_type` | The answer ID, the object type (`answer`) and the answer kind (for example `normal`). | | `author.name / author.headline` | Display name and profile headline of the answer author. | | `author.id / author.url_token` | Identifiers for the author. Use them to look up the author's profile or other answers. | | `question.id / question.title` | ID and title of the question this answer belongs to. | | `question.created / question.updated_time` | Unix timestamps for the parent question's creation and last update. | | `share_text` | Ready-to-post text with the question title, author name and the public answer link. | | `podcast_audio_enter.text` | Short label for the audio version of the answer, such as the number of listeners. | ## Notes - Take `answer_id` from the number after `/answer/` in a Zhihu answer URL. - `url` is an API address. The public page link is inside `share_text`, in the form `zhihu.com/question/{question_id}/answer/{answer_id}`. - To list other answers to the same question, pass `question.id` to [Zhihu Question Answers](/apis/zhihu/web/question-answers). - To read the discussion under an answer, use [Zhihu Answer Comments](/apis/zhihu/web/comment-v5). ## Pricing $0.001 per successful call. Failed calls are not charged. It is included in the daily free quota of each organization. ## Related APIs - [Zhihu AI Search Stream](/apis/zhihu/web/ai-search-stream): Returns streaming AI search results from Zhihu based on a query prompt. - [Zhihu Article Search](/apis/zhihu/web/article-search-v3): Search Zhihu articles and answers by keyword and get titles, excerpts, authors, vote and comment counts, with sorting, content type and time filters plus offse… - [Zhihu Column Article Detail](/apis/zhihu/web/column-article-detail): Returns detailed information and metadata for a specific Zhihu column article, including author profile details, using a provided article ID.
